title: Dist Bs 1 — octave-corrected reconstruction
method: Hardware-only periodicity and harmonic-family analysis from the historical reconstruction, with physical oscillator coarse tuning corrected from -36 to -12 semitones for WIDE off. All inferred played MIDI notes reduced by 24; sounding pitch, event times and velocities unchanged. No preset bytes modified.
uncertainties: Three-note crop from 1.94–3.20 seconds of the original demo; the earlier note with obvious pitch movement is outside this excerpt.
Played MIDI octave is conditional on the measured WIDE-off range and default system transpose. The original performance MIDI has not been recovered.
All velocities are fixed to 100, an unknown placeholder. Both tones have amplitude velocity sensitivity +8.
Original MIDI, controller events, system tuning/transposition, gain and processing are unavailable; no waveform null or absolute loudness calibration is justified.
Septum starts from reset; hardware was already sounding earlier in the recording. The crop begins in a quiet gap, with preset delay and reverb disabled.
